building.name: VILPE Express Store
building.description: Warehouse. Flat roof and green roof plus crawl space, built winter 2025. 6 Sense roof fans on the roof, 1 in the crawl space.

rules.old_alarm: Indoor RH above 90 % for 12 readings in a row (about 24 h). VILPE Sense guidebook p.25 default.
rules.mold_model: VTT mould growth model (Hukka & Viitanen 1999, Ojanen et al. 2010), class "very_sensitive". Best match to VILPE's own index.

smart_alert_levels.Watch: index rose 0.1 or more within 7 days (dashboard only)

watchdog.Fan stopped: 0 rpm over 48 h while outdoor air above -7 °C
watchdog.Sensor silent: no values over 24 h while the unit is online
watchdog.Outdoor sensor reads too warm: daytime average over 3 °C above the other outdoor sensors, per week
watchdog.Sensors likely swapped: outdoor sensor does not follow the other outdoor sensors, indoor sensor does

crawl_space_sensors_swapped_back.note: Only if the crawl space sensors are really swapped. Not confirmed by VILPE.
